title.narrative: To reduce the tuberculosis epidemic and burden by 20% in incidence rate and 35% in deaths by 2020 - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), Tuberculosis, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To reduce the tuberculosis epidermic and burden by 20% in incidence rate and 35% in deaths by 2020. The objectives of this program are: To increase TB case detection by 29% by 2020 by strengthening routine case notifications and addressing vulnerable groups such as elderly, prisoners, miners and diabetics.. To increase the percentage of childhood TB cases notified in the country from 10.6% to 15% by 2020 by integrating TB services into RCH, CTC and active case finding.. To increase MDR TB cases detected and enrolled for treatment from 17% of the estimated total cases among those notified to 84% by 2020 by scaling up new diagnostic technologies and decentralizing MDR TB services. To expand TB/HIV collaborative activities by ensuring that all TB patients are tested for HIV and those who test HIV positive are put on ART promptly and managed. To establish the magnitude of TB and increase case notification rate within the mining sector by 2020. To support implementation of good quality, accessible and equitable TB services in the country by 2020 through health and community systems strengthening and good programme management. To institute an efficient and integrated M&E system that ensures all indicators listed are tracked and reported timely.. To increase collaboration between the program and research/academic institutions on operational research
